reply.body:
Dear Qamar,
Thanks for your feedback. Please note that our application is fully supported with IPhone X and Face ID. Once you login using Face ID, username and password is still required to be entered on financial transactions as an additional layer of security. If Face ID is not working, you may check your phone settings. Please write to us at digital@mashreq.com if you need any help setting up Face ID. Thanks.
